entries.text:
SEC. 7134. RANGELAND RESEARCH PROGRAMS.

    Section 1483(a)(2) of the National Agricultural Research, Extension, 
and Teaching Policy Act of 1977 (7 U.S.C. 3336(a)(2)) is amended by 
striking ``2018'' and inserting ``2023''.
